messages.author: SATYAJIT KHATUA
messages.body:
Hi,
I don't know if this is a writting mistake or not. You command line reads
" MMPBSA-1.py<
http://mmpbsa-1.py/
> -O -i mmpbsa.in<
http://mmpbsa.in/
> -o mmpbsa.dat -do final_mmpbsa.dat -sp com_solvated.prmtop -cp com.prmtop -rp ras.prmtop -sp raf.prmtop -y md.crd"
But for ligand prmtop, it should be -lp keyword, not the -sp.
Best,
Satyajit Khatua

messages.author: Huang ZiJian
messages.body:
Hi,
From the error, I guess you need to explicitly define the *strip_mask* on the command line.
Hope this helps.
Regards,
Zijian

messages.author: SATYAJIT KHATUA
messages.body:
Hi,
Can you please check the compatibility of the four prmtop files? As far as
I know, the default setting for the strip_mask is enough to do the
subsequent calculation of binding free energy. From the following lines
" File
"/mnt/disk1/software/AMBER18/amber18/lib/python2.7/site-packages/MMPBSA_mods/make_trajs.py",
line 104, in make_trajectories
traj.Strip(INPUT['ligand_mask'])
File
"/mnt/disk1/software/AMBER18/amber18/lib/python2.7/site-packages/MMPBSA_mods/make_trajs.py",
line 646, in Strip
raise InternalError('Cannot pass no mask to Strip!')",
there may be some problem in selecting ligand msk (I guess). Are you trying
to reproduce the data given in the MMPBSA.py tutorial (
https://ambermd.org/tutorials/advanced/tutorial3/py_script/section6.php
)?
*Best,*
*Satyajit Khatua*
